p1: King David wrote a song about the Lord being near. He sang, “If I take the wings of the morning.” He pictured flying far across the sea.
Morning light spreads across the whole sky so fast. It is like the light has wings!
Even there, David said, “Your hand shall lead me. Your right hand shall hold me.”
p2: David also sang, “You made me inside my mother. I am fearfully and wonderfully made.” Here, fearfully does not mean scared. It means made with great care and wonder.
Wherever you go, the Lord is with you. Jesus promised, “I am with you always.” Wiggle your fingers and toes. Heavenly Father made you with great care!
old: One song-writer thought about something amazing: Heavenly Father knows everything about him! He sang a wondering song about it.
“Heavenly Father, You know when I sit down and when I stand up. You know my thoughts and every word before I say it. You are always with me!”
He knew that wherever he went — up high or far away — Heavenly Father was right there, watching over him with love.
“You made me,” he sang, “and I am wonderfully made!” Every part of us — our fingers, our smiles, our giggles — was carefully made by Heavenly Father.
Isn’t that wonderful? Heavenly Father knows you all the way through, and He made you just right. You are precious and special to Him.
